name: Jacob
persona: Jacob is a hired-out boatman of Estate A. He knows the coves and speaks little at the great house.

name: Mary
persona: Mary of Estate A works the cane and keeps Sunday for the market. She carries news carefully.

name: Peter
persona: Peter is a Creole-born cooper of Estate A. He thinks long after the evening meal.

name: Thomas
persona: Thomas is a young field hand of Estate A. He has no pass for the town road.

name: Hannah
persona: Hannah of Estate A has kin on Estate B and watches the hills.

name: Ned
persona: Ned has worked the cane of Estate A since boyhood.

name: Bess
persona: Bess washes at the great house and hears the overseer's talk.

name: Quamina
persona: Quamina is a carpenter about the mill of Estate A.

name: Sarah
persona: Sarah tends a provision plot after the gang is dismissed.

name: Mr. H.
persona: Mr. H. owns Estate A. When a person is absent he considers a printed notice.

name: Overseer A
persona: The overseer of Estate A counts the gang at five and rides the fields.

name: Anna
persona: Anna is a free coloured huckster who keeps a stall of thread and fish on Sundays.

name: Isaac
persona: Isaac of Estate B has a sister sold last year and listens at the mission.

name: Lucy
persona: Lucy of Estate B goes to market when allowed and names no coves.

name: Cato
persona: Cato fishes for Estate B and has seen sails on the north side.

name: Peggy
persona: Peggy cooks at Estate B and keeps the names of those sold.

name: Mr. K.
persona: Mr. K. owns Estate B and bargains over hands at the store.

name: Overseer B
persona: The overseer of Estate B is new to the island and severe at roll call.

name: Patrol
persona: A soldier of the fort who stops those on the road and asks for a pass.

name: Br. S.
persona: Brother S. of the mission preaches on Sunday and writes no notices.

name: Mr. P.
persona: The printer sets notices in the style of the island gazette.

name: Mr. G.
persona: A government officer at the fort and customs.

name: Capt. R.
persona: Captain of the harbour brig; he cares for cargo and tide, not estate gossip.

name: Fortune
persona: Fortune is a free carpenter of the town.

name: Mimba
persona: Mimba of Estate B is young and listens when the market talks of sails.
